bio.text: Napoleon Bracy Jr. represents House District 98 (Mobile County) in the Alabama House of Representatives, to which he was elected on November 2, 2010.
His political career began on the Prichard City Council, representing District 3, in 2004; he was reelected in 2008 and elected council president.
He graduated from Blount High School in 1995 and from Dillard University in 2000.
According to the legislature's profile, he is Manager of Diversity, Inclusion & Affirmative Action at Austal USA.
